title: Australian Navy Rescues Rower Crossing Pacific from California
titleZh: 澳大利亚海军在太平洋救起一名从加州划船的运动员
credits: Rod McGuirk reported this story for the Associated Press. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: A Lithuanian rower attempting to cross the Pacific Ocean has been rescued by an Australian warship after hitting stormy waters off the coast of Queensland state.
sentences.zh: 一名立陶宛划船者试图横渡太平洋，在抵达昆士兰州海岸时遭遇风浪，被一艘澳大利亚军舰救起。

sentences.en: Royal Australian Navy officer Justin Jones said in a statement that Aurimas Mockus was brought aboard the warship on March 3.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚皇家海军军官贾斯汀·琼斯在一份声明中表示，奥里马斯·莫库斯于3月3日被救上军舰。

sentences.en: The 44-year-old adventurer began his trip alone in October from San Diego, California.
sentences.zh: 这名44岁的冒险者于10月从加利福尼亚州的圣地亚哥独自启程。

sentences.en: He made it to within 740 kilometers of Australia’s mainland before running into a tropical cyclone.
sentences.zh: 他在距澳大利亚大陆仅740公里处时遭遇热带气旋。

sentences.en: Australia’s Maritime Safety Authority organized the rescue.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚海事安全组织发起了这次救援行动。

sentences.en: It said the enclosed boat that Mockus traveled in was mostly destroyed by the powerful waters.
sentences.zh: 该组织表示，莫库斯所乘坐的封闭式船只几乎被汹涌的海水摧毁。

sentences.en: He was only able to recover a few personal belongings from the boat.
sentences.zh: 他仅从船上抢救出几件个人物品。

sentences.en: Mockus was stranded for three days in the Coral Sea east of Queensland’s coastal city of Mackay.
sentences.zh: 莫库斯在昆士兰州沿海城市麦凯以东的珊瑚海被困三天。

sentences.en: His goal was to make it from California to the Australian state’s capital, Brisbane.
sentences.zh: 他的目标是从加利福尼亚州划到该州首府布里斯班。

sentences.en: The whole distance is about 12,000 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 全程约12000公里。

sentences.en: The rower turned on an emergency signal while experiencing stormy seas fueled by 80-kilometer-per-hour winds caused by Tropical Cyclone Alfred.
sentences.zh: 在由80公里/小时强风引发的狂风巨浪中，这名划船者启动了紧急信号，该风由热带气旋阿尔弗雷特造成。

sentences.en: That led to rescuers establishing radio contact with Mockus.
sentences.zh: 由此，救援人员与莫库斯建立了无线电联系。

sentences.en: Mockus reported he was "fatigued," the team said.
sentences.zh: 该团队表示，莫库斯报告称自己'疲惫不堪'。

sentences.en: Navy officials said the warship was taking Mockus to Sydney in New South Wales.
sentences.zh: 海军官员表示，军舰正将莫库斯送往新南威尔士州的悉尼。

sentences.en: Rowers traveling by themselves have crossed the Pacific Ocean nonstop in the past.
sentences.zh: 过去曾有其他独自划船者不间断地横渡太平洋。

sentences.en: Mockus was attempting to become one of the few to cross the sea alone and without stopping.
sentences.zh: 莫库斯试图成为少数几个独自且不间断横渡海洋的人之一。

sentences.en: Peter Bird of Britain became the first to do so in 1983.
sentences.zh: 英国人彼得·伯德于1983年成为首位完成壮举的人。

sentences.en: He rowed from San Francisco and was pulled behind another boat for the last 48 kilometers to the Australian mainland.
sentences.zh: 他从旧金山开始划行，最后48公里是被另一艘船拖拽至澳大利亚大陆。

sentences.en: Even though he did not complete the whole trip alone, he is considered to have rowed close enough to Australia to have made the crossing.
sentences.zh: 尽管他并未独自完成全程，但被认为已足够接近澳大利亚，从而完成了横渡。

sentences.en: Fellow British citizen John Beeden rowed from San Francisco to the Queensland city of Cairns in 2015.
sentences.zh: 同为英国公民的约翰·比登于2015年从旧金山划到昆士兰州的凯恩斯。

sentences.en: He is considered by some to have made the first successful crossing.
sentences.zh: 他被认为是首位成功完成横渡的人。

sentences.en: Australian Michelle Lee became the first woman to successfully make the crossing in 2023.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚人米歇尔·李于2023年成为首位成功横渡的女性。

sentences.en: She rowed from the Mexican coastal city of Ensenada to Port Douglas in Queensland.
sentences.zh: 她从墨西哥沿海城市恩塞纳达划船到昆士兰的多格拉斯港。

sentences.en: Another Australian, Tom Robinson, attempted to become the youngest to row across the Pacific in 2022.
sentences.zh: 另一位澳大利亚人汤姆·罗宾逊曾于2022年尝试成为最年轻横渡太平洋的人。

sentences.en: He was 24 years old at the time.
sentences.zh: 他当时24岁。

sentences.en: During his trip, Robinson took a rest in the Cook Islands.
sentences.zh: 在航行途中，罗宾逊在库克群岛休息。

sentences.en: He set out from Peru and spent 265 days at sea before he was rescued off the southwestern Pacific nation of Vanuatu in 2023.
sentences.zh: 他从秘鲁出发，在海上度过了265天，随后于2023年在南太平洋国家瓦努阿图西南海域获救。

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。

glossary.def: to move a boat through water using oars
someone who likes dangerous or exciting experiences
to leave (a person or animal) in a place without a way of leaving it — usually used as (be) stranded
